note: static = free-label classifier fit once on a held-out quarter of group buckets, deterministic ranking (sd=0, no policy-seed loop). static_matched = budget-matched: spends half of THAT budget's labels on random draws, fits, ranks the rest, no labels beyond the audit budget (sim_generic.py verbatim). greedy_online / ts_online = self-trained, online-refit every R verified labels, greedy has no bucket layout, ts_online Thompson-samples buckets. All four policies share the same fit_b/sim split and the same budget_n = int(budget_frac * len(sim)) within a resample/budget, so budget accounting is identical across policies. static_matched/greedy_online/ts_online averaged over --seeds policy seeds per resample.
